public_rationale: OpenAI demonstrated expansion plans and completed a $10 billion financing closing on April 15, 2025. That exceeded the previous $6.6 billion round. Its $260 billion pre-money valuation also exceeded the previous valuation and Zitron's suggested minimum. This supports the ordinary financing forecast when an executed first closing counts. It does not prove that raising capital was the only possible route to growth.
limitations: Counting the first closing rather than completion of every tranche is material to the result.
The predicted valuation figures were qualified estimates; the actual valuation was higher.
The evidence establishes occurrence, not unavoidable financial necessity.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: If it wishes to grow, OpenAI will have to close another round by mid-2025, raising more money (likely $10 billion) at a higher valuation (likely at least $175 billion, if not $200–250 billion).
conditions: in the event that it wishes to grow

statement.excerpt: In the event that it wishes to grow, OpenAI will have to close another round of funding by the middle of 2025, and raise both more money (likely $10 billion), and raise it at a higher valuation (likely at minimum $175 billion, if not $200 billion to $250 billion.)

from_speaker: In the event that it wishes to grow
close another round of funding by the middle of 2025
our_interpretation: I interpret the deadline as June 30, 2025.
The firm prediction is a larger financing at a higher valuation. The figures introduced by 'likely' are approximate expectations, not exact requirements or upper limits.
An executed first closing counts if it delivers more capital than the preceding round. An announcement or unsigned commitment does not count.
I interpret wishing to grow as demonstrated plans to expand infrastructure, products, or usage.
I assess the financing undertaken to support growth. Its occurrence cannot establish that every alternative financing strategy was impossible.
The monetary measure is reported gross financing terms, consistent with the post's discussion of company fundraising materials.
criteria.support_condition: OpenAI demonstrates an intention to expand and completes a new financing closing by June 30, 2025 that raises more than its October 2024 round at a higher transaction valuation.
criteria.contradiction_condition: OpenAI pursues expansion but does not complete such a financing closing by June 30, 2025, or the completed financing fails the amount or valuation comparison.
